staySafe.heroSubtitle: Know how to protect your personal information, identify suspicious requests, and participate in the census with confidence.
staySafe.overviewCard1Desc: Avoid unnecessarily sharing sensitive personal information.
staySafe.overviewCard2Desc: Verify an enumerator's identity before providing information.
staySafe.overviewCard3Desc: Never share OTPs, passwords, PINs, or banking credentials.
staySafe.overviewCard4Desc: Learn what to do if you encounter suspicious requests.
staySafe.privacyPoint1: Never share your bank PIN, password, or OTP.
staySafe.privacyPoint2: Do not provide financial information to someone claiming to be a census official.
staySafe.privacyPoint3: Be cautious about links received through unexpected SMS, WhatsApp messages, or emails.
staySafe.privacyPoint5: Only provide information through legitimate census channels.
staySafe.privacyPoint6: If something feels suspicious, stop and seek help.
staySafe.privacyDisclaimer: Census Saathi is an independent educational guidance platform and is not an official government enumeration portal.
staySafe.verifyStep1Desc: Ask the person to provide their official identification.
staySafe.verifyStep2Desc: Check the information carefully and use legitimate official channels if verification is required.
staySafe.verifyStep3Desc: Do not provide sensitive financial credentials or OTPs.
staySafe.scam1Desc: Someone asks you to pay money to complete your census participation.
staySafe.scam2Desc: Someone claims an OTP is required to verify your census details.
staySafe.scam3Desc: You receive a suspicious message asking you to click a link and enter personal information.
staySafe.scam4Desc: Someone asks for your bank account, card, PIN, or payment information.
staySafe.scamAction: Do not engage. Official census participation is always free and never requires banking details or OTPs.
staySafe.suspiciousPoint1: Stop and do not share additional information.
staySafe.suspiciousPoint3: Do not share OTPs, passwords, PINs, or banking credentials.
staySafe.suspiciousPoint4: Preserve the suspicious message/request if possible.
staySafe.suspiciousPoint5: Verify the request through a legitimate official channel.
staySafe.suspiciousPoint6: Seek appropriate help if you believe you have encountered fraud.
staySafe.check1: I know who is requesting my information.
staySafe.check3: I am not being asked for money.
staySafe.check4: I am not being asked for an OTP or password.
staySafe.check5: I understand what information I am providing.
staySafe.faq1Q: Should I share my OTP with an enumerator?
staySafe.faq1A: No, never share an OTP, password, or PIN with anyone, including a census enumerator.
staySafe.faq2Q: Should I pay money to participate in the census?
staySafe.faq2A: No, census participation is a free civic duty.
staySafe.faq3Q: What should I do if someone asks for my bank details?
staySafe.faq3A: Do not provide them. The census will never ask for your banking details.
staySafe.faq4Q: How can I verify a suspicious request?
staySafe.faq4A: Stop communicating with the suspicious party and verify through official government portals.
staySafe.faq5Q: Can I ask Saathi about a suspicious message?
staySafe.faq5A: Yes! Saathi can help you identify common red flags.
staySafe.pageDisclaimer: Safety information on this page is provided for educational purposes. Census Saathi is not an official government enumeration portal. For authoritative instructions, always verify information through official government sources.
